faq.q: What finance courses are available for business?
faq.a: Abadan & Co. runs courses on IFRS, RK taxation, budgeting and planning, treasury, financial analysis, audit, management accounting and transfer pricing. Courses run in person in Almaty and online.

faq.q: How much do finance courses cost?
faq.a: On the 2026 schedule — {minPrice} to {maxPrice} ₸ per participant, depending on the course and format. Online is cheaper than in person.

faq.q: Are there IFRS courses in Kazakhstan?
faq.a: Yes, the schedule includes several IFRS programmes — from a basic course to advanced topics adapted to Kazakhstani practice.
Trainers are practising finance professionals, auditors and consultants with experience at Kazakhstani and international companies. We have a pool of more than 200 experts.

faq.q: Can I take a finance course online?
faq.a: Yes, every course on the schedule has an online format with its own price.

faq.q: Are the courses suitable for oil and gas finance professionals?
faq.a: Yes, we have specialised programmes that account for the oil and gas industry: accounting at extractive companies, taxation of subsoil users, PRMS.
